name: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum) greenhouse optimum, literature-based estimate
status: Estimate for the demo. Values follow commonly cited greenhouse tomato ranges; exact numbers and DOIs still need to be checked against the sources before any use in a paper.

derivation.day_08_17: Tdb 24 = centre of a 22-26 degC day optimum for greenhouse tomato; VPD 0.8 kPa, inside the 0.3-1.0 kPa range given as ideal for tomato (Shamshiri et al. 2018)
derivation.night_19_06: Tdb 17 = centre of a 15-19 degC night optimum (Shamshiri et al. 2018; Peet and Welles 2005); VPD 0.5 kPa
derivation.transition_07_18: linear midpoint of day and night values
derivation.day_night_hours: assumption, same as the aehobak profile: 08-17 day, 19-06 night
derivation.default_zone_tolerances: tTol 1.5 degC (day 22.5-25.5, night 15.5-18.5), vpdTol 0.5 kPa, vpdMin 0.3 kPa (day 0.3-1.3, night 0.3-1.0)

references: Shamshiri RR, Jones JW, Thorp KR, Ahmad D, Che Man H, Taheri S (2018) Review of optimum temperature, humidity, and vapour pressure deficit for microclimate evaluation and control in greenhouse cultivation of tomato: a review. Int Agrophysics 32:287-302. doi:10.1515/intag-2017-0005
Peet MM, Welles G (2005) Greenhouse tomato production. In: Heuvelink E (ed) Tomatoes. CABI, Wallingford, pp 257-304
